festival.title: The Festival
festival.description: Sticks n’ Festival is an AI creative festival organized by SOUTS (Side Out Sticks). We showcase emerging storytelling formats powered by artificial intelligence on the big screen and beyond.
festival.description2: We believe artificial intelligence does not replace human creativity, it expands it. Sticks n’ Festival exists to support the creators building the next generation of narrative experiences.
festival.description3: If you are exploring what storytelling means in this new era, this space is for you.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.intro: To be eligible for submission to Sticks n' Festival, works must meet the following criteria:
items: Works must have been produced after January 1, 2024.
Artificial Intelligence tools must have played a significant role in the creative process (visual generation, audio design, scriptwriting, editing, or other production aspects).
Submissions are open to creators based in Latin America.
Creators must hold the necessary rights to submit and publicly screen their work.

aiShort.title: AI Short Film
aiShort.description: Narrative or documentary short films (up to 12 minutes) where AI played a significant role in production.

experimental.title: Experimental / Video Art
experimental.description: Abstract, non-narrative, or conceptual works (up to 10 minutes) exploring the aesthetics and possibilities of AI-generated media.

musicVideo.title: Music Video
musicVideo.description: Original music videos (up to 5 minutes) with significant AI-generated visual or audio components.

criteria.title: Selection Criteria
criteria.intro: Our jury evaluates submissions based on the following criteria:
items: Innovation in the use of AI tools.
Narrative and artistic quality.
Strong aesthetic vision.
Technical proficiency.
Thoughtful exploration of technology's role in creative expression.

process.title: Submission Process
items: Complete the online submission form with project details.
Provide a publicly accessible link to your work (Vimeo, YouTube, Google Drive, etc.). Ensure we have permission to view it (e.g., Unlisted link).
Include a brief description of how AI was used in your project.
Submit before the Submission Deadline: May 1, 2026.
You will receive a confirmation email upon successful submission.
Selected projects will be notified by May 15, 2026.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
items: By submitting, you grant Sticks n' Festival the right to publicly screen your work during the festival and use excerpts for promotional purposes (with proper credit).
You retain all intellectual property rights to your work.
Jury decisions are final and not subject to appeal.
Festival organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that do not meet eligibility criteria or contain offensive/illegal content.
There is no submission fee for Sticks n' Festival 2026.

contact.title: Questions?
contact.text: If you have questions about eligibility, submission requirements, or any other aspect of the festival, please contact us at yves@vapai.studio.

roles.felipeMachado: Head of AI Studio · Silverside AI

bios.felipeMachado: Brazilian creative director who started in motion design at MTV and now leads AI innovation at Silverside AI for brands like Coca-Cola, Google and Amazon. Champions 'hybrid creation' — blending AI's speed with human emotional depth.
bios.gabrielOrtiz: Argentine engineer and entrepreneur, founder of Pixart in 1999. Built Latin America's first fully automated smart factory and became the first Argentine company authorized by Qualcomm to design and produce motherboards locally.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Creators, artists, filmmakers, technologists, storytellers, and creative teams based in Latin America developing projects that incorporate AI into their creative process.
faq.a2: Films where AI tools (generative video, voice, script) play a significant role in the creative process.
faq.q3: Can I submit if I'm not from Latam?
faq.a3: Yes, you can participate. However, for this first edition, we are prioritizing projects from Latin American creators to highlight regional talent.
faq.q4: Do I need to attend the festival in person?
faq.a4: No. While we encourage creators to join us in Montevideo, physical attendance is not required. Selected works will be screened regardless, and we'll coordinate online participation when possible.
faq.a5: We will announce prize details closer to the festival. Awards include Best International AI Film and Best Uruguayan AI Film.
faq.q6: What percentage of my film needs to be AI-generated?
faq.a6: There's no strict percentage, but AI must play a significant creative role (not just color grading or upscaling). If AI shaped your visuals, narrative, audio, or performance, you're eligible.
faq.a7: All AI tools are welcome: Runway, Midjourney, Sora, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, open source models, custom models, etc. We value innovation and artistic vision over specific platforms.
faq.q8: Do I keep the rights to my work?
faq.a8: Yes, 100%. You retain all intellectual property and distribution rights. We only request festival screening rights for promotional purposes.
faq.a9: Yes! Submit as many works as you like across different categories. Each submission will be reviewed independently.
